title: Classify: Include vs. Extend Dilemma
scenario:
In an online store checkout system:
1. Every shopper who performs "Checkout" MUST have their inventory deducted via "Update Inventory" (mandatory).
2. During "Checkout", shoppers CAN OPTIONALLY choose to "Apply Discount Coupon" if they happen to have a coupon code (optional/conditional enhancement).
goal: Classify and connect the relationships between Checkout and its two related use cases using either «include» or «extend» in the correct directions.
learningObjective: Distinguish between «include» (mandatory sub-flow, points base -> included) and «extend» (optional conditional flow, points extension -> base).
hints: "Update Inventory" happens every single time. That is an «include»!
"Apply Discount Coupon" is optional. That is an «extend»!
CRITICAL: «extend» points FROM the optional extension ("Apply Discount Coupon") BACK TO the base ("Checkout")!
solutionExplanation: Remember the golden rule of UML: Base «include» points to Mandatory. Optional «extend» points BACK to Base.

solutions.description: Checkout includes Update Inventory; Apply Discount Coupon extends Checkout

edges.description: Optional coupon application points back to Checkout
